historical_scope: Present-build controls review, not a historical event reconstruction. Initial tank position and station are staged; the original game inventory is retained. Enemy fire is held for an isolated review.
limitations: Scripted Game inputs, not native OS mouse/keyboard capture. Original gameplay audio is retained. State checks and visual review are both required.
title: Exposed Commander holds RMB to raise P08 and presses LMB for three shots
caption: SCRIPTED INPUT / EXPOSED CUPOLA / RMB + LMB
input_audit: Initial open hatch and explicit head_out action are staged viewpoint setup, not a demonstrated hatch traversal. aim is held RMB; mg_coax is primary LMB and uses the same exposed-sidearm guard as the native dispatcher. Three fresh presses discharge ordinary P08 bullets; reload uses the same shared magazine/reserve and cannot add ammunition.
visual_acceptance: P08 rises before first trigger, physical recoil on three distinct fresh presses.
Ordinary reload animates without creating ammunition or firing tank weapons.
